## Saved-result schema (per config)

dashboard_results/<label>/
  portfolio.parquet       full daily portfolio_df from run_backtest
                          (date index; portfolio_value, cash, total_fees,
                          n_positions columns)
  trades.parquet          full trades_df (date, ticker, action, shares,
                          price, fee)
  scores.json             latest per-rebalance composite scores dict
  holdings.json           final_holdings dict (ticker -> shares,
                          entry_price, stop_price)
  meta.json               label, saved_at, full BacktestConfig.to_dict(),
                          split_date, n_days, n_trades, n_holdings,
                          runtime_seconds

The dashboard imports five compute helpers from dashboard.py
(_summarize_period, _sleeve_metrics, _top_traded_stocks, _series_stats,
_download_benchmark) — pure data/compute; no HTML emission used.

## Saved-result contents (segment 5 lock-in seeds)

default config              584 days, 589 trades, 489 ticker scores, 11 holdings
                            saved 2026-05-04T17:01, backtest runtime 2.73s
best_*_706 (locked best)    584 days, 201 trades, 490 ticker scores,  9 holdings
                            saved 2026-05-04T17:01, backtest runtime 2.07s

## Tabs implemented

1. Overview — Plotly equity curve (Strategy/SPY/QQQ normalized to 100),
   metric tiles (Total Return, Sharpe, Max DD, Trades, Win Rate, Alpha,
   Beta, Correlation), today's macro composite + sizing tier under the
   selected config, real-portfolio placeholder for segment 4.

2. Optuna explorer — trial-count metric strip; trial-number-vs-score
   scatter with running-best overlay; 9 param-vs-score scatters in a
   3-column grid (one per tunable); top-10 trials dataframe; best-trial
   drilldown (config + components from JSONL).

3. Macro state — composite score over time with 50/75/100% sizing-tier
   bands shaded (color-coded against the selected config's thresholds),
   distribution percentile metrics (mean, std, p10/p25/p50/p75/p90),
   six per-component line charts (one per FRED series).

4. Positions — table of open holdings sorted by composite score, with
   shares, entry, stop, stop-gap %, stop warning flag (within 3% of
   stop), days held (from trades), and composite. Clarification caption
   that current price is intentionally not refreshed (segment 4 work).

5. Trades log — filterable round-trip table (ticker, exit reason,
   winners-only checkbox); summary metrics over the filtered subset
   (closed count, avg return/trade, avg hold days, win rate); full
   trade list; top-traded tickers table.

## Sidebar

Source radio: Default config / Best trial of selected study /
Custom trial number. When non-default, study selectbox defaulted to
the locked-best study. Custom-trial path uses st.number_input bounded
to the study's trial range, defaulting to study.best_trial.number.

Header strip shows model provenance (trained_at, eval_cutoff,
n_tickers) and macro cache window/component count for orientation.

## Deviations from the inventory plan

None substantive. One minor add: a header caption strip that prints
model + macro provenance under the title. Not in the original plan
but is one line of compute and saves the user from having to dig
into model.meta.json to see what they are looking at. Easy to remove
if you'd rather.

## How to launch

cd src
streamlit run dashboard_app.py

Default browser opens to http://localhost:8501. Use the sidebar to
switch configs; tabs auto-update.

## Re-saving results after a new --full study

cd src
python optuna_runner.py --save-results

This re-runs validation backtests for default config + the locked
trial #706. To save a different trial after a new study, edit the
LOCKED_BEST_STUDY / LOCKED_BEST_TRIAL constants at the top of
save_dashboard_results in optuna_runner.py, or extend the CLI to
accept a --study-name / --trial-number pair (~5 lines).
